{{Otheruses|feline}}
[[File:Nexu-SWE.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Nexu/Legends|Nexu]], a feline species from [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]]]
'''Felines''', also referred to as '''felinoids''', were a group of animal [[Species/Legends|species]] defined by [[Cat/Legends|cat]]-like traits, such as a very flexible body, slit-pupiled [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], a tail, padded, clawed [[Limb/Legends|hands]] and feet, heightened senses, and hunting and tracking instincts.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> While typically found among [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]], non-mammalian creatures could also be classified within this group, such as [[Mawvorr]].<ref name="Voss feline">{{TORcite|type=other|Achievement: "Voss Feline Handler"}}</ref> 

Other examples of feline life forms included non-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] animals like the [[Tooka/Legends|tooka]],<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|characters|tooka|tooka}}</ref> [[Manka cat/Legends|manka cat]],<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> [[tusk cat]],<ref name="WoSW">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> and [[Loth-cat/Legends|loth-cat]],<ref name="TOR News">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230901-0|text=Galactic Season 5 "Confidence in Power"}}</ref> and [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species such as the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]],<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> [[Srrors'tok]],<ref name="G9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> [[Togorian/Legends|Togorians]], [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]], and [[Farghul/Legends|Farghul]].
